cards.card_text: Mephibosheth has a young son named Mica, and everyone who lives in Ziba's house is Mephibosheth's ___.
cards.verse_text: And Mephibosheth had a young son named Mica, and all who dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants of Mephibosheth.
